query: SELECT s.id, s.title, s.artist, s.albumCover, COUNT(*) as voteCount FROM songs s LEFT JOIN votes v ON s.id = v.songId WHERE v.createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY s.id HAVING voteCount > 0 ORDER BY voteCount DESC LIMIT 5;
